title: Twist 3 Urban Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Airoh Twist 3 Urban Blue is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1444g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~100 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Entry-level MX with excellent ventilation and replaceable liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Urban Blue colorway; Dirt/MX specific fit designed for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Airoh Twist 3 Urban Blue: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Airoh Twist 3 Urban Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Airoh's Dirt / MX lineup, the Twist 3 Urban Blue brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Airoh Twist 3 Urban Blue represents Airoh's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Airoh Twist 3 Urban Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
